editorial: When desperation pushes a decorated veteran into a midnight heist, hope fuels the pace of an adrenaline‑charged thriller. Every tense moment feels personal, as the camera closes in on quiet rooms and humming machines, turning ordinary locales into battlegrounds of fear and hope. Joaquin Phoenix’s portrayal of Will Sharp is a low‑key storm, his silence amplifying the tension that spikes with every screeching AC and flicker of fluorescent lights. While the climax drags slightly, the relentless pacing keeps you glued to the screen. This high‑octane, violent crime thriller delivers a heart‑pounding experience that fans of thrillers with sharp, kinetic energy will appreciate.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of fast-paced crime thrillers who crave visceral action.
